    m.id AS migration_id,
    m.status AS migration_status,
    m.source_compute,
    m.dest_compute,
    i.display_name,
    nic.network_info
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid

)

  e.migration_status,
  e.source_compute,
  e.dest_compute,

  e.network_info,
